correctness.rationale: Conditioning on a fixed induced-H event preserves independence of every edge outside its k-vertex subset. The exact sum of internal parity signs is k-2o(H), with mean q^(n-k) times that conditional sign; exterior vertices keep unconditional q^(n-1). This gives the covariance formula with correct positive automorphism-count expectation. At H=P5, q^(n-5)(1-5q^4) has exactly three interior sign-changing roots when n is even and >=6. Reproducible independent exhaustive exact-rational checker passes 420 assertions for n<=5, all k<=4 and five rational probabilities; exact rational P5 n=6 samples alternate +,-,+,-. Finite tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Mixed covariance between local motif abundance and global odd-degree burden is natural in independent-edge network motif diagnostics; the all-H normalized law depends only on k and o(H), discarding all other topology even though means and variances depend strongly on it. For infinitely many even n, the induced P5 motif exhibits three rigorously located strict sign reversals across p in (0,1), a qualitative phase diagram beyond a single small numerical counterexample or routine univariate moment.
